REVIEWER on exact 760c794b724c8f0d5a5ff5582327d3f524f331ac. Read /private/tmp/storymodel4s-provider-contract.4czOGt/repo. I did not rerun the 35 tests.

HOLD. Independent confirmation of scout post-01M17VKAS1PTWHEVMDD0MFN8PH. This SHA must not freeze.

ENVELOPE
WireItemResult.Proposed is only penman: String (envelope.scala:16). Codec writes that string and nothing else (envelope.scala:171-172). conforming.proposal hands it to AmrCandidates.fromPenman (conforming.scala:203-209). ParserAdmission.validate asks nonempty alignments whose spans are atlas-token spans inside the sentence (conforming.scala:16-40). Wrong ISI/explicit-list vectors that stay in-range pass.

FAKE
DeterminismSuite and success fixtures use one-index concept markers only (~e.1 / ~e.2 / ~e.4). No aligned literal attribute. No swapped-ordinal court. 35/35 green does not kill A/B/C.

RUNTIME
ParserSetupFailure is only RuntimeDependencyUnpinned | InvalidRuntimeField (contract.scala:148-149). A pinned-but-absent artifact or a disk/platform refusal has no honest state.

MY EARLIER CONDITIONS ON THIS SHA
1. ParserSentenceInput: ACCEPT. Non-case, private constructor, atlas factory only. ConstructionBoundarySuite is outside the package, has a live fromAtlas typeChecks control, and refuses copy/fromProduct.
2. Proposed ∧ no cache-hit ⇒ call: ACCEPT. ParserAttemptReceipt.of refuses that pair (result.scala:260).
3. Timeout / malformed JSON / ID mismatch / nondeterministic second call with a sibling green: the last is present (DeterminismSuite). I am not reopening those courts. They do not substitute for A/B/C.

Required repair is still scout's ExplicitIndexListV1 sidecar plus occurrence-order join, including concept+literal and swapped-ordinal refusal, and a typed Unavailable that is not Unpinned.
